welcome.title: Dear Guests, we are delighted to welcome you to this corner of peace.
welcome.imgAlt: The Abbey of San Vittore next to the house, with the Frasassi gorge in the background
welcome.caption: San Vittore · Genga
welcome.lead: We chose this name because we believe that today's greatest luxury is rediscovering the rhythm of nature.
welcome.p1: The river that flows before you, the Sentino, is not merely part of the landscape: it is the tireless sculptor that, over a million years, has given life to the Frasassi Caves.
welcome.p2: Settle in, open the window and listen closely: its voice is here to accompany your rest, refresh your days and remind you that wonder begins just outside the door.
welcome.p3: We wish you an unforgettable stay among relaxation, water and stone.

pull.quote: « Today's greatest luxury is rediscovering the rhythm of nature. »

legend.title: The legend of the Sentino and the mountain.
legend.p1: It is said that thousands of years ago the river Sentino fell in love with the great mountain of stone that blocked its path.
legend.p2: Unable to climb over it, the river chose instead to whisper its melody. Day after day, seeking passage through its heart of stone with the infinite patience only water possesses, the river found its way into the deepest darkness.
legend.p3: There, in the silence of the earth, water began to dance with stone, shaping cathedrals of crystal, white sails and giants of limestone. And so it created what the world now calls «Frasassi Caves».

intro.title: A doorway onto the wonders of Marche.
intro.lead: Welcome to «La Voce del Sentino»: our holiday home is the ideal starting point to explore the natural and cultural wonders of Marche.
intro.p1: The property is located in San Vittore delle Chiuse — a medieval village in the municipality of Genga (AN), at the entrance to the striking Gola della Rossa and Frasassi gorge.
intro.p2: It is celebrated for its Romanesque abbey and encircled by a natural amphitheatre of mountains.
intro.p3: Set in a quiet, panoramic landscape, the house offers a restful stay without sacrificing the convenience of being close to the main attractions.

privacy.h_categories: Categories of data processed through the site

privacy.p_nav: The computer systems and software procedures that operate the Site acquire, during their normal operation, certain personal data whose transmission is implicit in the use of Internet communication protocols. The data may be used to establish liability in the event of hypothetical computer crimes against the Site or against third parties.

privacy.li_purpose_2: Fulfilment of contractual obligations on the part of the Controller. The legal basis is art. 6(1)(b) of EU Regulation 679/2016: processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which the data subject is a party.
